o.text: Borrowed from Russian па́спорт (pásport), from French passeport.
From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (qïz-, “to be hot, be red”), from Proto-Turkic *kï̄ŕ- (“to be hot, to redden; glow”). Related to Azerbaijani qızıl (“gold”).
